The winner was determined at White's discretion.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/09/14/dana-white-announces-new-50000-bonus-for-ufc-331-in-honor-of-mobland/91766906007/|title=Dana White announces special $50,000 'proper chaos bonus' for UFC 331|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Danny Segura|date=2026-09-14|access-date=2026-09-16}}</ref>

While the UFC usually gives out four bonus awards for each event, three "Fan Bonus of the Night" will be awarded by [[Crypto.com]], as part of their UFC sponsorship incentive fight kits deal, for every pay-per-view event starting with UFC 273.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/4/7/23014643/ufc-to-debut-crypto-com-bitcoin-fan-bonus-of-the-night-for-fighters-at-ufc-273|title=UFC to debut Crypto.com Bitcoin 'Fan Bonus of the Night' for fighters at UFC 273|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. * '''Third Place:''' Petr Yan
